d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from China PR vs Fiji in Group H of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. China PR got an 8-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Kuang Zhaolei and Wan Xiang both struck twice, with Zhao Songyuan, Zhang Junhao and Liang Shiyu also on target and a Sialesi Vatanitawake own goal adding to Fiji's misery. China PR finish third in Group H, just behind Morocco on goal difference, and must wait to see if they advance as one of the best third-placed teams, while Fiji exit the tournament.
